title: Half the Water in Your Glass Is Older Than the Sun

scenes.text: Up to half the water in your glass is older than the Sun.
It formed as ice in a freezing cloud between the stars, before our star existed.
The clue is heavy water. Ice born in deep space carries extra heavy hydrogen, and our oceans have that fingerprint.
In 2014, scientists simulated a newborn Sun making water from scratch. It couldn't match that pattern. The water came first.
It outlived the birth of the Sun and every dinosaur.
Now it's in your glass. Older than the Sun.

description:
Up to half of the water on Earth is older than the Sun.
A 2014 study in Science led by Ilsedore Cleeves at the University of Michigan found that 30 to 50 percent of Earth's water carries a heavy-hydrogen signature that could only have formed as interstellar ice, before the Sun was born 4.6 billion years ago.
Does your next sip taste any different now?

first_comment: Some of the water in you has been water for over 4.6 billion years. What's the oldest thing you've ever touched?
